Adm. Arthur W. Radford

Chairman · 1953–1957 · at the opening, 1955-11-01

Chairman on 1 November 1955. Had wanted to bomb at Dien Bien Phu eighteen months earlier; the advisers who went in that November were the consolation.

The office

The Joint Staff, the Pentagon, Arlington, Virginia. The Chairman’s office is on the E-ring, second floor, river side; the Chiefs meet in the “Tank”, Room 2E924, and from 1972 in the Gold Room next to it.
